newsitem.title: USA: CompuServe subscriptions slip in Q2.
newsitem.headline: CompuServe subscriptions slip in Q2.

text.p: CompuServe Corp said Thursday that subscriptions to its main CompuServe Interactive online service declined slightly in its fiscal second quarter ended October 31.
During the quarter, worldwide direct subscribers fell to 3,312,000 from 3,313,000, it said.
International subscribers grew by 56,000 to 1,120,000, while North American users declined by 57,000 to 2,192,000. International subscribers are largely concentrated in Europe.
CompuServe's Japanese licensee, NIFTY-Serve, had 2,029,000 subscribers, up from 1,864,000 at the end of the second quarter.

The company said subscribers to its WOW! family-oriented consumer service, which it had announced plans to disband, rose to 102,000 during the third quarter from 92,000 at the end of the second quarter.
It said subscribers to SPRYNET, its Internet-only access service, grew to 218,000 from 163,000.
